title: Technical Sales Consultant
description:
***Candidate MUST be located in Sao Paulo Metro, Jundai, Parana, Santa Catarina or Rio Grande do Sul

Hexagon’s Manufacturing Intelligence division is growing business and expanding the team in Brazil, therefore seeking for Technical Sales Consultants for its team.

Why Join Us?

Hexagon is the global leader in measurement technologies. We provide confidence that vital industries rely on to build, navigate, and innovate. From microns to Mars, our solutions ensure productivity, quality, and sustainability in everything from manufacturing and construction to mining and autonomous systems.

Hexagon (Nasdaq Stockholm: HEXA B) has approximately 24,800 employees in 50 countries and net sales of approximately 5.4bn EUR.

Learn more at hexagon.com.

Job Description

The Technical Sales Consultants that will join our team are result-oriented with a proven track record of exceeding targets and driving revenue growth. Skilled in building and nurturing strategic client relationships to understand their unique business needs and provide tailored technology solutions. Excel at analyzing market trends, conducting needs assessments, and recommending innovative strategies to optimize customer success. Committed to delivering exceptional customer experiences and surpassing expectations through effective communication, negotiation, and problem-solving abilities.

These positions will be based in our São Paulo office, near the Santo Amaro region. These are Hybrid positions.

Job Responsibilities

  • Develop and execute strategic sales plans to acquire new clients and expand business with existing accounts, leading to a great increase in revenue year-over-year.
  • Conduct thorough market research and competitive analysis to identify sales opportunities in target industries, resulting in a relevant growth in market share.
  • Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to assess customer needs, design customized solutions, and present persuasive proposals to key stakeholders.
  • Manage end-to-end sales cycle, including lead generation, qualification, negotiation, contract closure, and post-sales relationship management.
  • Proactively engage with customers post-implementation to ensure optimal solution adoption, customer satisfaction, and identify upselling opportunities.
  • CRM experience and discipline are a must.
  • Successfully achieve and exceed quarterly sales quotas, consistently ranking among the top performers in the region.
  • Cultivate and maintain productive relationships with key accounts, resulting in a strong increase in repeat business.
  • Conduct product demonstrations and deliver compelling presentations to educate customers on the value and benefits of solutions.
  • Collaborate with the marketing team to develop targeted campaigns and drive lead generation initiatives.
  • Actively participate in trade shows and industry conferences to expand the network and generate new business opportunities.

Qualifications

  • Associate’s degree in Engineering, Business Administration, Technical Metrology or equivalent combination of education and work experience.
  • Strong sales knowledge understanding of the manufacturing industry, system integrators and related technologies.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills in Portuguese and English.
  • Professional English, capable of communicating across diverse teams.
  • Proven experience in sales.
  • Self-motivated and results-oriented with a track record of meeting or exceeding sales targets and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to build and maintain strong relationships with clients.
  • Excellent customer service skills, building and maintaining strong relationships.
  • Experience in Salesforce or other CRM solutions.
  • Proficiency in MS Office.
  • Willingness to travel as needed.
  • Works independently as well as in a team environment.

What We Offer

  • Competitive salary with opportunities for growth and development.
  • Benefits package aligned with the Brazilian market.
  • Opportunities to grow and move within a global company known for its commitment to employee growth and innovation.

At Hexagon’s Manufacturing Intelligence, our spirited energy and engagement are evident in our commitment to our work, passion for what we do and the speed at which we achieve it. Here you will find the opportunity to build your career, develop professionally, and explore opportunities across a large, diversified company that prides itself on its innovative spirit and commitment to integrity.

We strive to attract the most talented and dynamic individuals in their fields because our success is in our people! Our culture encourages independent thinking and a team mentality.

About Us

At Hexagon, we do not just measure the world – we define its future.

As the global leader in measurement technologies, we provide the confidence that vital industries rely on to build, navigate, and innovate.

From microns to Mars, our solutions drive productivity, quality, safety, and sustainability across aerospace, agriculture, automotive, construction, manufacturing, and mining.

Yet measurement is only the beginning. We bridge the physical and digital worlds with cutting-edge metrology, reality capture, and positioning solutions – making industries and cities safer, smarter, and more sustainable. Looking forward, we are striving to enable our customers to meet sustainability and demographic challenges – ultimately advancing them towards truly autonomous solutions.

Measurement is the foundation of progress. When it has to be right, it has to be Hexagon.

title: Pre-sales Technical Advisor - Digital signature experience
description:
Build your future with Sovos.

If you're seeking a career where innovation meets impact, you've come to the right place. As a global leader, Sovos is transforming tax compliance from a business requirement to a force for growth while revolutionizing how businesses navigate the ever-changing regulatory landscape.

At Sovos, we're dedicated to more than just solving compliance challenges – we're committed to making a positive and lasting difference in everything we do. Our teams operate on the modern edge of digital technology, working not only to solve complex business challenges but also to enrich our personal, professional, and local communities.

Our purpose-built systems provide the tools you need to thrive in a world where governments demand increased visibility, faster reporting and greater control over business processes. Excited about the possibilities? So are we!

Don’t worry if you don't check all the boxes – apply anyway! We're focused on hiring the right people, not just the "right" resume. It's not about what you've done elsewhere; it's all about what you're capable of doing here.

The Work You'll Do:

The Pre-Sales Technical Advisor will work with the Direct Sales and Alliance teams to provide technical support during the sales cycle for our solutions, acting as the bridge between sales and product, professional services, and support. You will utilize technical expertise to support the sales team and deliver solutions that meet customer needs.

The Pre-Sales Technical Advisor will be adept at leveraging technical expertise to deliver innovative solutions, ensuring seamless integration of product offerings with client needs. This role requires strong communication skills to enable effective cross-functional collaboration and the successful execution of complex sales initiatives. Known for developing robust sales strategies, conducting impactful product demonstrations, and providing comprehensive technical support to both clients and internal sales teams

More specifically you will:

  • Provide domain expertise around trust, digital signature, KYC, biometric and/or SaaS based or outsourced services
  • Maintain an expert-level understanding of the functionality and technical architecture of our products.
  • Assist in the client discovery process to help uncover unforeseen challenges and ensure the proper offering is being proposed.
  • Develop a firm understanding of customer needs, pain points, and requirements around the compliance process for the Brazilian market, aligning Sovos solutions to eliminate pain points and fulfill needs.
  • Work closely with Sovos’ Sales team to conduct sales and solution presentations for Strategic Enterprise and Mid-Size clients.
  • Design and deliver customized solution demonstrations using Sovos SaaS solutions and services.
  • Maintain and continually improve demonstration capabilities, conducting internal Sales department training, demo system props and proposal content.
  • Assist in the creation of RFP and RFI responses for prospective new clients.
  • Work closely with Implementation and Product Teams to ensure a seamless handoff from sales to onboarding for new clients.
  • Act with integrity and demonstrate ethical behavior in all matters with stakeholders.
  • Take full responsibility for ensuring internal and external customer satisfaction.
  • Demonstrate initiative, drive, and determination to achieve results, success, and growth.
  • Maintain a high level of energy, enthusiasm, engagement, and commitment to action.
  • Demonstrate a high degree of self-awareness and a commitment to personal development and learning.

What We Need From You:

  • Demonstrate a high degree of self-awareness and a commitment to personal development and learning.
  • Bachelor’s in related field, or equivalent combination of experience and education
  • Excellent English communication skills
  • Minimum 1 year of pre-sales experience with trust, digital signature, KYC, biometric and/or SaaS based or outsourced services
  • Customer facing experience, preferred
  • Strong team orientation with a history of working collaboratively in a fast paced environment
  • Ability to manage multiple projects at once and prioritize activities
  • Thorough knowledge of MS Office software including Excel, Word, & PowerPoint
  • Self-motivated and strong drive to succeed
  • Moderate travel required for client meetings, trade shows, Sovos Events, and special projects

Essential Job Functions:

  • Interact effectively with teammates, colleagues, and customers.
  • Comprehend and communicate complex concepts.
  • Analyze and resolve complex problems.
  • Utilize technology (e.g., phone systems, computer hardware, and software applications) to fulfill work requirements.

What Does Sovos Offer You?

The tools to enhance your life - because we want you to enjoy your life outside of work and inside

  • Comprehensive Health benefits
  • Life insurance
  • Bi-Weekly Meeting Free Days
  • Mentoring Programs
  • Globally recognized Training and Development programs

Sovos is an equal opportunity employer committed to providing an environment that celebrates diversity and where equal employment opportunities are available to all applicants and employees. We do not discriminate against race, color, religions, national origin, age, sex, marital status, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic provided by law. At Sovos, all employees are encouraged to bring their whole selves to work.

Company Background

Sovos is a global provider of tax, compliance and trust solutions and services that enable businesses to navigate an increasingly regulated world with true confidence. Purpose-built for always-on compliance capabilities, our scalable IT-driven solutions meet the demands of an evolving and complex global regulatory landscape. Sovos’ cloud-based software platform provides an unparalleled level of integration with business applications and government compliance processes.

More than 100,000 customers in 100+ countries – including half the Fortune 500 – trust Sovos for their compliance needs. Sovos annually processes more than three billion transactions across 19,000 global tax jurisdictions. Bolstered by a robust partner program more than 400 strong, Sovos brings to bear an unrivaled global network for companies across industries and geographies. Founded in 1979, Sovos has operations across the Americas and Europe, and is owned by Hg and TA Associates. For more information visit and follow us on LinkedIn.

title: Regional Sales Manager
description:
Our Mission

At Palo Alto Networks everything starts and ends with our mission:

Being the cybersecurity partner of choice, protecting our digital way of life.
Our vision is a world where each day is safer and more secure than the one before. We are a company built on the foundation of challenging and disrupting the way things are done, and we’re looking for innovators who are as committed to shaping the future of cybersecurity as we are.

Who We Are

We take our mission of protecting the digital way of life seriously. We are relentless in protecting our customers and we believe that the unique ideas of every member of our team contributes to our collective success. Our values were crowdsourced by employees and are brought to life through each of us everyday - from disruptive innovation and collaboration, to execution. From showing up for each other with integrity to creating an environment where we all feel included.

As a member of our team, you will be shaping the future of cybersecurity. We work fast, value ongoing learning, and we respect each employee as a unique individual. Knowing we all have different needs, our development and personal wellbeing programs are designed to give you choice in how you are supported. This includes our FLEXBenefits wellbeing spending account with over 1,000 eligible items selected by employees, our mental and financial health resources, and our personalized learning opportunities - just to name a few!

Job Description

Your Career

The Regional Sales Manager is a significant driver of company revenue and growth. As an experienced and dynamic sales professional, you’re responsible for leading and driving sales engagements. You’re motivated by the desire to solve critical challenges facing our customer’s secure environment, so you’re prepared to connect them with a solution for every stage of threat prevention.

You’ll be responsible for meeting and exceeding your quota by crafting and implementing strategic territory plans targeting deployments of the Palo Alto Networks Next Generation Security Platform. This is a unique opportunity for a closer with a go-getter mentality to win business and market share by actively displacing competing technologies.

Palo Alto Networks is leading the charge in platformization, offering best-in-breed solutions that enable customers to build a truly zero-trust security architecture and navigate critical transformations. To ensure our sales team is equipped to guide customers, we've developed FLIGHT, an immersive onboarding program. Flight blends virtual and in-person learning at our headquarters, where new sales hires will participate in dynamic cohorts, fully dedicated to their training without customer distractions. This focused approach ensures they emerge as well-prepared sales professionals, ready to help customers leverage our comprehensive portfolio.

Your Impact

  • As a Regional Sales Manager, you will drive and orchestrate complex sales cycles and work with our internal partners and teams to best serve the customer

title: Cell Therapy Manufacturing - External Supplier Quality Management (SQM) Associate
description:
Cell Therapy Manufacturing - External Supplier Quality Management (SQM) Associate

Nexcella, Inc.

Sao Paulo / Hybrid

Our 3 Core Values

  • Intelligence
  • Integrity
  • Initiative

What You'll Do

The Supplier Quality Management (SQM) role will be responsible for the oversight of external suppliers, including Clinical and CMC vendors. The individual will establish and maintain a compliant supplier quality program, perform and/or coordinate supplier audits, and ensure vendor compliance with regulatory and company requirements.

Key Responsibilities

  • Manage Quality oversight of Clinical and CMC suppliers (raw material suppliers, CROs, CDMOs, testing laboratories).
  • Conduct initial supplier quality assessments, vendor qualifications, and risk-based evaluations.
  • Identify and determine audit requirements for critical and high risk suppliers.
  • Develop audit schedules and perform on site and remote audits to assess supplier compliance with cGMP/GCP/GLP.
  • Ensure timely closure of supplier audit findings and CAPA follow up.
  • Maintain approved vendor list (AVL) and vendor quality agreements.
  • Partner with Procurement, Clinical, and Technical Operations teams to manage supplier performance.
  • Provide training and guidance on supplier quality management to internal stakeholders.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Life Sciences
  • 4–6 years of experience in supplier quality management within the pharmaceutical/biotech sector.
  • Strong knowledge of ICH Q10, ICH E6 (R2), and global supplier management expectations.
  • Demonstrated experience in conducting audits (GMP/GCP).
  • Excellent organizational and negotiation skills.

· Willingness to travel (10–20%) for site/vendor audits.

About Nexcella, Inc.

Nexcella, Inc. is a subsidiary of Immix Biopharma, Inc. (ImmixBio) (Nasdaq: IMMX), a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company developing cell therapies for AL Amyloidosis and other serious diseases. Our lead candidate is sterically-optimized BCMA-targeted chimeric antigen receptor T (CAR-T) cell therapy NXC-201 with a “digital filter” that filters out non-specific activation. NXC-201 is being evaluated in the U.S. multi-center study for relapsed/refractory AL Amyloidosis NEXICART-2 (NCT ), with a registrational design. Interim results were presented at ASCO 2025 in an oral presentation by Heather Landau, M.D. of Memorial Sloan Kettering Cancer Center. NXC-201 has been awarded Regenerative Medicine Advanced Therapy (RMAT) by the US FDA and Orphan Drug Designation (ODD) by FDA and in the EU by the EMA. Learn more at and

Desejável

Benefícios

Cuidados com o seu bem-estar

Aqui na Deloitte, acreditamos que saúde e bem-estar não são apenas projetos, e sim uma mudança de cultura. Queremos que você coloque em prática todo o seu talento e desenvolva uma carreira de sucesso com as pessoas, com equilíbrio entre Mente, Corpo e Propósito. Oportunidade de fazer parte de uma cultura inclusiva

Você pode ser quem realmente é com oportunidade igual de crescimento. Para fortalecer esse compromisso, desenvolvemos uma estratégia global de D&I com os 5 pilares – Origens, Delas, LGBT+, Inclui e Gerações. Destacamos que todas as nossas vagas estão abertas ao público PcD.

title: Consultor(a) de Relacionamento_Florianópolis (SC)_Vaga Afirmativa para Pessoas Negras
description:
Sobre a vaga:

A Juntos Somos Mais é uma startup de tecnologia atuando no mercado da construção civil desde 2018 que tem como acionistas três gigantes do mercado: Votorantim Cimentos, Gerdau e Tigre.

Fazemos isso por meio de tecnologia, com produtos próprios, parcerias, aquisições e com um time empreendedor, de alta performance, que é movido pela nossa paixão em transformar vidas! Hoje contamos com mais de 40 marcas participantes, mais de 1.2 milhões de membros entre lojistas, vendedores e profissionais de obra, 100 mil lojas e movimentamos mais de 10 bilhões de reais em nossa Loja Virtual em 2024, e crescemos mais a cada dia.

O nosso time é empreendedor e apaixonado por propor as melhores soluções para os nossos usuários, fortalecendo o varejo de materiais de construção e impactando a vida de milhares de pessoas. Através disso, construímos relações sólidas para sermos o maior ecossistema da construção civil.

Você fará parte do time Comercial.

Base: Florianópolis - SC

Você será a conexão direta entre a nossa Loja Virtual e as lojas de material de construção da sua região.

Seu papel será garantir que as lojas parceiras entendam, usem e se beneficiem do nosso marketplace, fortalecendo nossa presença em campo, ofertando as indústrias participantes e trazendo aprendizados para dentro de casa.

Seu dia a dia será assim:

  • Visitar lojas da sua carteira para converter o cliente com pedidos na nossa Loja Virtual;
  • Tirar dúvidas sobre campanhas, regras e funcionalidades;
  • Apoiar as indústrias e distribuidores parceiros localmente, sendo um ponto de contato estratégico e confiável;

  • Monitorar tendências do varejo e concorrência na região;
  • Manter relacionamento próximo com donos, gerentes e vendedores — somos uma marca próxima e presente!

O que esperamos de você:

  • Experiência prévia em área comercial (presencial);
  • Boa comunicação e escuta ativa — você vai lidar com muitos perfis diferentes;
  • Organização para lidar com uma carteira diversa e realizar visitas diárias;
  • Interesse genuíno em aprender sobre o setor de material de construção (experiência prévia é um plus!);
  • Perfil mão na massa, que resolve, propõe e faz acontecer;
  • Disponibilidade para viagens dentro da região;
  • Ensino superior em andamento ou concluído (Administração, Marketing, Comércio Exterior ou áreas afins);
  • CNH válida e Excel no mínimo intermediário.

O que pode te destacar:

  • Conhecimento prévio em marketplace B2B;
  • Ter atuado com rotina externa e visitas diárias;
  • Ter facilidade para apresentar, treinar e engajar clientes.

Por que vale a pena:

Você vai trabalhar em um programa que conecta varejo, indústria e tecnologia para transformar um dos setores mais importantes do país — e fazer isso com autonomia, responsabilidade e muita troca. Aqui, a gente valoriza quem constrói junto, compartilha aprendizados e busca soluções com propósito.

Nosso processo seletivo e compromisso com a diversidade

Na #Juntos, valorizamos a jornada de aprendizagem mútua: queremos descobrir, juntos, o potencial de cada pessoa em todas as etapas do processo. Nosso objetivo é criar uma experiência transparente, justa e eficiente, alinhada aos nossos valores e à nossa cultura de protagonismo e impacto.

Acreditamos que um time diverso e autêntico é essencial para gerar soluções verdadeiramente inovadoras. Aqui, você será encorajado a ser você mesmo(a), trazendo suas singularidades para somar ao coletivo. Promovemos inclusão de forma concreta, com ações afirmativas que buscam ampliar vozes de diferentes origens e perspectivas.

Se você busca um ambiente onde pode ser quem é, aprender com liberdade e contribuir com impacto real, seu lugar pode ser aqui. Vem construir com a gente o maior ecossistema da construção civil!

Benefícios de ser um Construtor(a) na #Juntos

Por aqui, acreditamos que cuidar das pessoas é tão importante quanto alcançar resultados. Por isso, oferecemos um pacote de benefícios pensado para apoiar sua saúde, bem-estar, desenvolvimento e qualidade de vida — dentro e fora do trabalho.

title: Senior Demand Planner – FMCG (Position is based in Angola!)
description:
International Opportunity! Position is based in Angola!

You will be joining a well-established market leader, large group with diversified businesses portfolio, reporting to the Demand Planning Manager and responsible for the following:

Key Accountabilities:

  • Develop and maintain accurate demand forecasts for decision-making
  • Analyze sales data and market trends to improve forecasting
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams on factors that impact demand
  • Monitor sales and refine forecasts based on changing conditions
  • Communicate forecast updates to supply planning teams
  • Take ownership and proactively address data quality issues
  • Create, maintain, and manage visual data tools for leadership

Key Responsibilities:

  • Review and analyze historical sales data to identify trends and patterns that can be used to improve accuracy of future forecasts
  • Collaborate with sales, marketing, and other stakeholders to gather information on upcoming promotions, product launches, and other factors that may impact demand
  • Develop statistical models and algorithms to create accurate demand forecasts for different product types
  • Continuously monitor and track actual sales performance against forecast and make necessary adjustments to the forecast as needed
  • Communicate forecast recommendations and updates to stakeholders across the organization, including senior leadership
  • Ensure that any add/delete items are promptly updated in the system to avoid impacting forecast accuracy
  • Work with IT and Analytics Data teams to ensure that demand data is available on time for extract and analysis
  • Validate that sales forecast is pulled into the correct line
  • Notify the BI team to push data on time to ensure that reporting and analysis can be done in a timely manner
  • Publish LE (latest estimate) forecasts and other relevant reports to keep stakeholders informed of demand trends and performance
  • Develop and maintain demand planning dashboard to provide real-time visibility into forecasting and demand planning metrics. As well as be able to generate reports and visualizations to communicate forecast accuracy, demand trends, and potential risks to stakeholders, enabling informed decision-making
  • Monitor forecast accuracy and identify areas of improvement to enhance the reliability and precision of demand planning
  • Provide training and support to end-users on utilizing the demand planning dashboard, ensuring widespread adoption and utilization across the organization

Key Requirements:

  • Willing and able to work in Angola
  • Bachelor's Degree as a minimum in relevant field including Finance, Math or Engineering; MBA and/or other professional qualifications are highly preferred
  • 4+ years of Demand Planning experience in a large organization
  • Strong understanding of supply chain management, logistics, and inventory / production planning
  • Proficiency in using demand planning and forecasting tools is necessary,
  • Proficiency in using forecast accuracy KPIs
  • Strong experience with ERP and demand planning systems (e.g., SAP APO, Oracle Demantra, Kinaxis, Anaplan)
  • Advanced Excel and data analysis skills; experience with BI tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau)
  • Knowledge of statistical forecasting methods and demand modeling
  • Solid understanding of distribution networks, inventory management, and supply chain dynamics
  • Familiarity with S&OP processes and cross-functional planning
  • Proficiency in analyzing large sets of data and using data visualization tools to identify trends, patterns, and insight
  • Prior FMCG experience will be a plus
  • Ability to influence the decision makers
  • Highest standards of accuracy and precision
  • Articulate with excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • Highly-driven and self-motivated
  • Proven ability to work with ambiguity

title: Cell Therapy Supply Chain Logistics Associate
description:
Cell Therapy Supply Chain Logistics Associate

Nexcella, Inc.

Sao Paulo / Hybrid

Our 3 Core Values

  • Intelligence
  • Integrity
  • Initiative

What You'll Do

Overseeing the patient journey from screening through treatment across CAR-T therapies You will work cross-functionally with internal and external stakeholders to ensure therapies reach patients as quickly and efficiently as possible.

Key Responsibilities

You will play a key role in supporting our Global Patient Supply Operations:

  • Work cross functionally between clinical operations, manufacturing, and quality to effectively manage patient products from leukapheresis collection through drug
  • product infusion
  • Develop and improve SOPs, work instructions, and training materials which are used to ensure seamless end to end patient journey
  • Manage logistics providers which are responsible for transportation of patient
  • material (starting material, intermediates, and final product)
  • Ensure chain of custody (COC) and chain of Identity (COI) measures are maintained throughout all patient journey activities
  • Support CMO activities which includes logistics support for all patient related
  • material including CMO storage capacity management
  • Support/manage clinical sites as primary point of contact (POC) for scheduling and
  • general inquiries regarding patient journey activities

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in relevant discipline (or equivalent experience)
  • 1-5 years of work experience or the equivalent combination of education and
  • experience
  • Previous industry experience in a biotech or pharma company

About Nexcella, Inc.

Nexcella, Inc. is a subsidiary of Immix Biopharma, Inc. (ImmixBio) (Nasdaq: IMMX), a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company developing cell therapies for AL Amyloidosis and other serious diseases. Our lead candidate is sterically-optimized BCMA-targeted chimeric antigen receptor T (CAR-T) cell therapy NXC-201 with a “digital filter” that filters out non-specific activation. NXC-201 is being evaluated in the U.S. multi-center study for relapsed/refractory AL Amyloidosis NEXICART-2 (NCT ), with a registrational design. Interim results were presented at ASCO 2025 in an oral presentation by Heather Landau, M.D. of Memorial Sloan Kettering Cancer Center. Sobre a Tereos

Com visão de longo prazo no processamento de matérias-primas agrícolas e desenvolvimento de produtos alimentícios de qualidade, a Tereos é uma das líderes nos mercados de açúcar, álcool/etanol e amidos. Tereos no Brasil

A Tereos no Brasil é composta pela Tereos Açúcar & Energia Brasil, Tereos Amido & Adoçantes Brasil e Tereos Commodities Brasil. No noroeste do Estado de São Paulo, a Tereos Açúcar & Energia Brasil concentra suas sete unidades de processamento e duas refinarias. A Tereos Amido & Adoçantes Brasil, com operação em Palmital (SP), diversifica o portfólio da Tereos Brasil com a fabricação de produtos derivados de milho. A Tereos Commodities opera como trading e possui escritórios em diversos países.

description:
Cell Therapy Manufacturing - External Quality Assurance (QA) Associate

Nexcella, Inc.

Sao Paulo / Hybrid

Our 3 Core Values

  • Intelligence
  • Integrity
  • Initiative

What You'll Do

The Specialist, External Quality Assurance (EQA) will provide oversight of Contract Development and Manufacturing Organizations (CDMOs) and testing laboratories to ensure compliance with cGMP, regulatory requirements, and company quality standards. This role is critical in supporting ongoing manufacturing campaigns, batch release, and ensuring timely resolution of quality events.

Key Responsibilities

  • Review and approve deviations, Out-of-Specification (OOS) investigations, CAPAs, and change controls from CDMOs and external testing laboratories.
  • Monitor manufacturing campaigns, production activities, and resolve issues during routine manufacturing.
  • Review and approve QC/analytical results and Certificates of Analysis from CDMOs/external labs.
  • Review and approve production lot records for compliance prior to disposition.
  • Perform GMP reviews of incoming documentation (batch records, test data, release packages).
  • Ensure timely escalation and resolution of manufacturing and quality issues.
  • Collaborate with internal cross-functional teams (QA, QC, Supply Chain, Regulatory, CMC) to ensure readiness for release and regulatory filings.
  • Support audit readiness activities for Regulatory Authority inspections.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Life Sciences, Chemistry, Biochemistry, Engineering, or related discipline.
  • 3–5 years of QA experience in the biopharmaceutical or cell/gene therapy industry.
  • Strong knowledge of cGMP, ICH Q7/Q10, FDA 21 CFR Parts 210/211.
  • Experience with CDMO oversight, lot release, and deviation management.
  • Excellent communication and problem-solving skills.

About Nexcella, Inc.

Nexcella, Inc. is a subsidiary of Immix Biopharma, Inc. (ImmixBio) (Nasdaq: IMMX), a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company developing cell therapies for AL Amyloidosis and other serious diseases. Our lead candidate is sterically-optimized BCMA-targeted chimeric antigen receptor T (CAR-T) cell therapy NXC-201 with a “digital filter” that filters out non-specific activation. NXC-201 is being evaluated in the U.S. multi-center study for relapsed/refractory AL Amyloidosis NEXICART-2 (NCT ), with a registrational design. Interim results were presented at ASCO 2025 in an oral presentation by Heather Landau, M.D. of Memorial Sloan Kettering Cancer Center. title: Analista de Consumer Insights Sênior | CRM (Rio de Janeiro ou São Paulo)
description:
Descrição da vaga

Com uma trajetória de 95 anos, a Americanas S.A. está presente na vida de milhões de brasileiros.

Nossas +1600 lojas físicas estão distribuídas por todos os estados do Brasil, em mais de 800 cidades, levando nossos produtos e serviços a mais de 40 milhões de clientes em todo o país.

A área de Consumer Insights na área de Clientes tem como missão compreender profundamente os clientes e transformar esses conhecimentos em ações estratégicas para o negócio. Ela combina dados de pesquisa de mercado, comportamento de consumo e informações de CRM para criar uma visão completa do cliente, apoiar decisões de marketing, fidelização, comunicação e experiência, e antecipar tendências de consumo. O foco é gerar insights que conectem comportamento do cliente a estratégias de negócio, garantindo que campanhas, ofertas e ações sejam relevantes, personalizadas e eficazes.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Nesse time, você terá a oportunidade de:

  • Atuar em projetos de pesquisa de forma completa, desde a definição de objetivos e metodologia até a entrega de insights e recomendações estratégicas
  • Configurar e gerenciar pesquisas em plataformas proprietárias e de parceiros externos, assegurando que sejam utilizadas de acordo com os objetivos de cada estudo
  • Colaborar com equipes internas e parceiros externos na coleta e análise de dados
  • Desenvolver relatórios e apresentações claros e objetivos, comunicando resultados e insights que contribuam para tomada de ação e decisões
  • Contribuir de forma ativa em discussões estratégicas, oferecendo uma visão informada sobre estudos e insights de pesquisas realizadas
  • Manter-se atualizado(a) sobre tendências e metodologias de pesquisa, garantindo a aplicação das melhores práticas de mercado

Requisitos e qualificações

O que esperamos de você para essa vaga:

  • Graduação completa em marketing, administração, engenharias e áreas correlatas
  • Ampla experiência em funções de pesquisa de mercado, com habilidade em análise e interpretação de dados e aplicação de insights
  • Domínio de metodologias quantitativas (como pesquisas online, NPS, clusterização, segmentação) e qualitativas (entrevistas em profundidade, focus group)
  • Conhecimento em SQL, BigQuery, Looker
  • Capacidade de comunicação (escrita e verbal), organização pessoal e de processos
  • Domínio de Pacote Office, principalmente Excel e Powerpoint

Será um diferencial, caso você conheça:

  • Conhecimento estatístico para análise de dados internos e resultados de testes e pesquisas
  • Experiência com CRM

OBS: Nossos processos seletivos estão sendo conduzidos totalmente online, portanto, fique atento nos emails e no spam.

Informações adicionais

Nossos benefícios:

Somos adeptos ao regime e benefícios CLT, oferecemos:

  • Vale Refeição;
  • Plano de saúde Bradesco;
  • Plano odontológico Amil;
  • Wellhub;
  • Seguro de vida;
  • Fazemos nossa proposta salarial de acordo com o nosso plano de cargos e salários, sua pretensão salarial e avaliação técnica;
  • Somos uma Empresa Cidadã: 180 dias de licença maternidade e 20 dias licença paternidade;
  • Descontos em nossas lojas físicas, após o período de experiência;
  • Ambiente colaborativo: perfeito pra ensinar e aprender muito.

Local de Trabalho: Rio de Janeiro

QUEM SOMOS

Quem Somos:

Somos a Americanas, uma das maiores varejistas do país, com mais de 95 anos de história. Nossa marca, amada pelos brasileiros, tem o propósito de resolver a vida das famílias de maneira simples e descomplicada. A integração das mais de 1.600 lojas, presentes em todos os estados, e um e-commerce que complementa a experiência do físico nos permitem a realização de uma estratégia de vendas multicanal e eficiente, com foco na geração de caixa e na rentabilidade. Venha construir o futuro com a gente!

Nosso Jeito:

Nossa cultura é centrada no cliente, e buscamos constantemente soluções para aprimorar sua experiência. Valorizamos um jeito de trabalhar simples e descomplicado, que realmente gera impacto positivo na vida das pessoas. Aqui, incentivamos o trabalho em equipe e a troca de ideias, pois acreditamos que é assim que crescemos juntos, tanto como profissionais quanto como pessoas.

Valores e Propósito:

Nosso propósito é resolver a vida das pessoas, de maneira simples e descomplicada, guiada por valores autênticos e que representem a nossa gente. Buscamos entregar resultados com integridade, sempre servindo o cliente da melhor forma; priorizamos a conveniência em cada experiência, seja nas lojas, no site ou no coração de milhões de famílias; valorizamos a pluralidade e a resiliência, além de reconhecer e cuidar das nossas pessoas. Acima de tudo, nos comprometemos a ter um impacto positivo em tudo o que fazemos .

Diversidade e inclusão:

A Americanas S.A. acredita que diferentes perspectivas enriquecem o ambiente de trabalho. Por isso, temos o objetivo de promover um lugar cada vez mais diverso, inclusivo e acolhedor. Estamos construindo a cada dia uma cultura com base no respeito e valorização das diferenças, encorajando as pessoas a serem quem elas são, independente de gênero, etnia, raça, orientação sexual, religião ou deficiência. Nós acreditamos na integração das diversas culturas e tradições do Brasil, e queremos refletir a riqueza e a pluralidade do nosso país. Todas as nossas oportunidades são trabalhadas com base nesse princípio.

If you are dynamic, tech-savvy, and always online to learn more, this part-time flexible project is the perfect fit for you!
A Day in the Life of a Personalized Internet Assessor:
In this role, you’ll be analyzing and providing feedback on texts, pages, images, and other types of information for top search engines, using an online tool
Through reviewing and rating search results for relevance and quality, you’ll be helping to improve the overall user experience for millions of search engine users, including yourself. Join our team today and start putting your skills to work for one of the world's leading search engines.
The estimated hourly earnings for this role are 5.00 USD per hour. Payment is based on completed tasks, with the potential for higher earnings base on productivity.
TELUS Digital AI Community
Our global AI Community is a vibrant network of 1 million+ contributors from diverse backgrounds who help our customers collect, enhance, train, translate, and localize content to build better AI models. Become part of our growing community and make an impact supporting the machine learning models of some of the world’s largest brands.
Qualification path
No previous professional experience is required to apply to this role, however, working on this project will require you to pass the basic requirements and go through a standard assessment process. This is a part-time long-term project and your work will be subject to our standard quality assurance checks during the term of this agreement.
Basic Requirements
Working as a freelancer with excellent communication skills in Portuguese
Being a resident in Brazil for the last 5 consecutive years and having familiarity with current and historical business, media, sport, news, social media, and cultural affairs in Brazil
Active use of Gmail, Google+, and other forms of social media and experience in the use of web browsers to navigate and interact with a variety of content
Daily access to a broadband internet connection, a smartphone (Android 5.0, iOS 14 or higher), and a personal computer to work on.
Assessment
In order to be hired into the program, you’ll take a language assessment and an open book qualification exam that will determine your suitability for the position and complete ID verification. Don’t worry, our team will provide you with guidelines and learning materials before your exam. You will be required to complete the exam in a specific timeframe but at your convenience!
Equal Opportunity
All qualified applicants will receive consideration for a contractual relationship without regard to race, color, religion, gender identity, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status. At TELUS Digital AI, we are proud to offer equal opportunities and are committed to creating a
diverse and inclusive community. All aspects of selection are based on applicants’ qualifications, merits, competence, and performance without regard to any characteristic related to diversity.

Looking for a freelance opportunity where you can make an impact on technology from the comfort of your home?
If you are dynamic, tech-savvy, and always online to learn more, this part-time flexible project is the perfect fit for you!
A Day in the Life of a Personalized Internet Assessor:
In this role, you’ll be analyzing and providing feedback on texts, pages, images, and other types of information for top search engines, using an online tool
Through reviewing and rating search results for relevance and quality, you’ll be helping to improve the overall user experience for millions of search engine users, including yourself. Join our team today and start putting your skills to work for one of the world's leading search engines.
The estimated hourly earnings for this role are 5.00 USD per hour. Payment is based on completed tasks, with the potential for higher earnings base on productivity.
TELUS Digital AI Community
Our global AI Community is a vibrant network of 1 million+ contributors from diverse backgrounds who help our customers collect, enhance, train, translate, and localize content to build better AI models. Become part of our growing community and make an impact supporting the machine learning models of some of the world’s largest brands.
Qualification path
No previous professional experience is required to apply to this role, however, working on this project will require you to pass the basic requirements and go through a standard assessment process. This is a part-time long-term project and your work will be subject to our standard quality assurance checks during the term of this agreement.
Basic Requirements
Working as a freelancer with excellent communication skills in Portuguese
Being a resident in Brazil for the last 5 consecutive years and having familiarity with current and historical business, media, sport, news, social media, and cultural affairs in Brazil
Active use of Gmail, Google+, and other forms of social media and experience in the use of web browsers to navigate and interact with a variety of content
Daily access to a broadband internet connection, a smartphone (Android 5.0, iOS 14 or higher), and a personal computer to work on.
Assessment
In order to be hired into the program, you’ll take a language assessment and an open book qualification exam that will determine your suitability for the position and complete ID verification. Don’t worry, our team will provide you with guidelines and learning materials before your exam. You will be required to complete the exam in a specific timeframe but at your convenience!
Equal Opportunity
All qualified applicants will receive consideration for a contractual relationship without regard to race, color, religion, gender identity, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status. At TELUS Digital AI, we are proud to offer equal opportunities and are committed to creating a
diverse and inclusive community. All aspects of selection are based on applicants’ qualifications, merits, competence, and performance without regard to any characteristic related to diversity.

title: Garçom
description:
Descrição da vaga:

Ofereça os seus serviços de garçom para hotéis através da b2bhotel. Você tem flexibilidade para escolher os seus horários de trabalho e quais serviços deseja realizar. O controle da sua agenda é feito de forma online e os pagamentos são feitos semanalmente, de acordo com os serviços realizados naquela semana.


O que preciso para me aplicar?

Possuir MEI,

Possuir ao menos 3 meses de experiência comprovada na área,

Possuir ao menos 1 referência de hotel onde tenha trabalhado.

title: Manicure
description:
Realize atendimentos de Manicure, Pedicure e Spa dos pés. É preciso seguir os padrões de qualidade, higiene e biossegurança definidos pela Bluma. Também é esperado que você mantenha postura profissional, pontualidade e bom relacionamento com a equipe e com o público atendido. Todos os materiais necessários para os atendimentos, assim como o uniforme completo, serão disponibilizados pela Bluma. Os atendimento serão realizados em estabelecimentos da Bluma localizados em aeroportos.
Caso o(a) candidato(a) ainda não tenha MEI, a Bluma oferece apoio na abertura. Candidatos(as) com MEI pendente ou irregular serão desclassificadas.

check list

title: Especialista em sistemas de granadas
description:
US$ 1100 – 2800 por mês

Serviço oficial nas unidades militares das Forças Armadas da Ucrânia

Responsabilidades

  • Realizar tarefas de guarda e patrulha
  • Deslocamentos à linha de frente
  • Proteger objetos estratégicos e infraestrutura crítica
  • Realizar tarefas de preparo de posições para defesa

Requisitos

  • Idioma de comunicação - Espanhol ou Inglês
  • Treinamento militar ou experiência relevante será um diferencial
  • Disponibilidade para atuar por longos períodos no campo
  • Disponibilidade para atuar em zona de guerra
  • Sem vícios em álcool ou drogas
  • Sem distinção de nacionalidade

  • US$ 500 durante o treinamento, US$ 1100–2800 durante as tarefas (dependendo do local), + US$ 1670 por cada 30 dias na linha de frente
  • Assinatura de contrato de 3 anos (rescisão possível após 6 meses), período de experiência de 2 meses
  • Um mês de treinamento especializado e exercícios com instrutores profissionais
  • Alimentação, vestuário, equipamentos, alojamento e segurança médica e social garantidos pelo governo
  • Compensação financeira em caso de lesão
  • Licença anual de 30 dias e outras licenças adicionais por motivos familiares

US$ 1100 – 2800 por mês

Serviço oficial nas unidades militares das Forças Armadas da Ucrânia

Responsabilidades

  • Preparar sistemas de artilharia e morteiros para disparo
  • Realizar manutenção e controle técnico de munições
  • Preparar munições de artilharia
  • Execução das ordens do comandante para mira e ajuste de resposta de fogo
  • Garantir segurança no manuseio de munições
  • Participar de operações de combate

Requisitos

  • Idioma de comunicação - Espanhol ou Inglês
  • Boa resistência física
  • Disponibilidade para atuar em zona de guerra
  • Aptidão para o serviço militar por questões de saúde
  • Sem vícios em álcool ou drogas
  • Treinamento militar ou experiência relevante será um diferencial
  • Conhecimento básico do funcionamento de sistemas de artilharia será um diferencial
  • Capacidade de aprender rapidamente e de executar tarefas designadas de forma ágil
  • Sem distinção de nacionalidade

Condições

  • US$ 500 durante o treinamento, US$ 1100–2800 durante as tarefas (dependendo do local), + US$ 1670 por cada 30 dias na linha de frente
  • Assinatura de contrato de 3 anos (rescisão possível após 6 meses), período de experiência de 2 meses
  • Um mês de treinamento especializado e exercícios com instrutores profissionais
  • Alimentação, vestuário, equipamentos, alojamento e segurança médica e social garantidos pelo governo
  • Compensação financeira em caso de lesão
  • Licença anual de 30 dias e outras licenças adicionais por motivos familiares

title: Designer de Produto/ Desenvolvimento de produto - PRESENCIAL
description:
Estamos em busca de um(a) designer de Produto/ desenvolvimento de produto (louças e metais) para integrar nosso time!

Local: Gramado - RS

Tipo de vaga: Presencial

Descrição do Cargo: Estamos buscando um designer de Produto/ desenvolvimento de produto (louças e metais) e Responsável por planejar, desenvolver e acompanhar o portfólio de produtos de louças e metais sanitários, garantindo alinhamento com a estratégia da marca, demandas do mercado e viabilidade técnica e comercial. Atua desde a concepção até o pós-lançamento, conectando design, engenharia, produção e marketing.

Principais Responsabilidades

1. Pesquisa & Planejamento

  • Realizar pesquisa de tendências, concorrência e benchmarks nacionais e internacionais;
  • Identificar oportunidades de novos produtos e melhorias de linha;
  • Apoiar na definição do portfólio estratégico

2. Desenvolvimento de Produto

  • Elaborar briefings detalhados para novos produtos (design, dimensões, acabamentos, funcionalidades);
  • Acompanhar a criação de protótipos e moldes junto às áreas técnicas e fornecedores;
  • Validar desenhos técnicos, normas de desempenho (ex: ABNT/NBR, ISO), ergonomia e funcionamento hidráulico;

3. Gestão de Linha

  • Acompanhar ciclo de vida dos produtos: lançamento, maturidade, renovação e descontinuação;
  • Monitorar performance da linha (mix, rentabilidade, giro, margem, feedback comercial);
  • Propor ajustes no portfólio e novas soluções por faixa de preço ou aplicação

4. Interface com Áreas Internas

  • Apoiar a área de marketing com especificações técnicas, comparativos e argumentos de venda;

Requisitos e Qualificações

  • Formação em Design de Produto ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência prévia em desenvolvimento de produtos industriais ou acabamentos;
  • Vivência com fornecedores nacionais e internacionais (especialmente China/Ásia);
  • Inglês intermediário ou avançado.

title: Consultor de negócios
description:
Vaga Consultor Comercial PJ - Salário: R$ 6.000,00 por mês.

Buscamos um profissional experiente no mercado de móveis planejados de alto padrão, com vivência comercial em empresas do setor. Buscamos alguém com perfil estratégico, que saiba vender e construir relacionamentos sólidos com clientes.

Responsabilidades: Atendimento a Arquitetos e Designers de Interiores.

Proporcionar consultoria especializada para arquitetos e designers na escolha de móveis estofados que atendam aos projetos de alto padrão. Apresentar o portfólio de produtos, esclarecendo características técnicas, materiais e benefícios de cada linha de móveis. Realizar visitas técnicas, apresentações e reuniões de acompanhamento com profissionais da área de arquitetura e design. Atendimento ao Consumidor Final:

Prestar atendimento personalizado e consultivo aos clientes finais, identificando suas necessidades e ajudando a selecionar móveis estofados adequados aos seus projetos ou preferências pessoais. Gerenciar pedidos e prazos de entrega, garantindo a satisfação do cliente e a fidelização. Acompanhar o pós-venda, assegurando a qualidade do produto entregue e a resolução de eventuais problemas.

Gestão de Relacionamento Comercial: Desenvolver e manter um relacionamento sólido com os principais clientes e parceiros comerciais (arquitetos, lojas de design e empresas do setor de móveis).

Identificar oportunidades de novos negócios e expandir a presença da marca no mercado de alto padrão.

Organizar e coordenar eventos e ações de marketing direcionadas aos profissionais da área e ao consumidor final, como lançamentos de novos produtos e promoções exclusivas. Análise de Mercado e Vendas: Monitorar o desempenho das vendas e elaborar relatórios para a gestão, sugerindo melhorias ou ajustes nas estratégias de vendas. Analisar as tendências do mercado de móveis de alto padrão e identificar oportunidades de inovação no portfólio de produtos. Participar de feiras, exposições e eventos do setor de móveis e design de interiores. Apoio na Definição de Estratégias Comerciais: Auxiliar na formulação de estratégias de vendas e ações comerciais que atendam aos diferentes segmentos de clientes (arquitetos, designers e consumidores finais).Colaborar com o time de marketing para o desenvolvimento de materiais promocionais e campanhas focadas na alta qualidade e exclusividade dos produtos.

Formação: Graduação em Administração, Marketing, Design de Interiores, Arquitetura ou áreas correlatas.

Experiência: Vivência prévia na área comercial, preferencialmente no setor de móveis de alto padrão ou no mercado de decoração e design de interiores.

Conhecimentos: Habilidade em negociação, atendimento ao cliente, e conhecimento do mercado de móveis estofados de luxo. Conhecimento sobre o universo de arquitetura e design de interiores é um diferencial.

Habilidades Técnicas: Facilidade no uso de ferramentas de CRM, Excel e sistemas de gestão de vendas.

Perfil Pessoal: Boa comunicação, postura profissional, proatividade, e capacidade de trabalhar de forma independente e em equipe.

Tipo de vaga: PJ

Salário fixo: R$ 3.000,00 + Comissão

Média de Ganho: R$ 6.000,00

Horário: Segunda a sexta-feira 09h00 às 18h00 e aos Sábados: 09h00 às 13h00

title: HR Operations senior specialist
description:
HR Policy Enablement & Governance:

  • Develop, implement, and maintain comprehensive HR operations policies and SOPs that align with business goals and compliance requirements.
  • Ensure HR policies are consistently applied across all business units.
  • Regularly review work with relevant department and update HR policies to reflect changes in employment laws and best practices.

HR Process Standardization & Optimization:

  • Design, document, and continuously improve HR processes to enhance efficiency and compliance.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure HR processes are well-integrated and operationally sound.
  • Establish clear workflows and guidelines for employee lifecycle processes, including onboarding, offboarding, probation and internal mobility, etc..

Quality Controal & Employee Experience：

  • Ensure seamless execution of HR policies to improve employee experience and operational efficiency.
  • Provide training and communication on policy updates and process changes to HR teams and managers.
  • Conduct periodic audits to verify adherence to HR policies and recommend corrective actions where needed.
  • Implement a quality audit framework to regularly assess HR operations, identify gaps, and drive continuous improvements.

title: Encarregado de Açougue
description:
Foco do Cargo:

Liderar nossa equipe de açougue com paixão e expertise, garantindo a excelência no atendimento, a qualidade impecável dos nossos cortes e a organização impecável do setor, tudo com o selo de praticidade e qualidade que só o Mais Prático Supermercados oferece aos seus clientes.

Descrição Curta do Cargo:

Lidere a arte do corte e encante nossos clientes! Como Encarregado(a) de Açougue no Mais Prático, você será o(a) maestro(a) da nossa seção de carnes, responsável por inspirar sua equipe, garantir a qualidade dos produtos e proporcionar uma experiência de compra prática e deliciosa para todos.

Descrição Detalhada do Cargo e suas Atribuições e Responsabilidades:

No Mais Prático Supermercados, o(a) Encarregado(a) de Açougue é peça fundamental para o sucesso da nossa loja. Suas responsabilidades incluem:

Liderança Inspiradora:

  • Motivar, treinar e desenvolver a equipe de açougueiros, cultivando um ambiente de trabalho colaborativo e focado em resultados.
  • Distribuir tarefas, orientar sobre os melhores cortes e técnicas de manipulação, garantindo a eficiência e a qualidade do trabalho.
  • Realizar reuniões periódicas com a equipe para alinhamento de metas, comunicação de novidades e feedback.
  • Identificar necessidades de treinamento e propor ações para o desenvolvimento profissional da equipe.

Garantia da Qualidade e Apresentação:

  • Supervisionar o recebimento, armazenamento e manipulação das carnes, assegurando a conformidade com os padrões de higiene e segurança alimentar.
  • Realizar cortes de carnes de acordo com as especificações dos clientes e os padrões do Mais Prático, prezando pela apresentação atrativa dos produtos nas vitrines.
  • Controlar a qualidade, o frescor e a validade dos produtos, garantindo que apenas o melhor chegue à mesa dos nossos clientes.
  • Organizar e manter a limpeza impecável do setor, incluindo equipamentos, balcões e câmaras frias, seguindo os procedimentos sanitários.

Atendimento ao Cliente Mais Prático:

  • Atender os clientes com cordialidade e conhecimento, oferecendo informações sobre os diferentes tipos de carne, cortes, preparos e dicas de conservação.
  • Realizar cortes especiais sob encomenda, demonstrando habilidade e atenção às necessidades dos clientes.
  • Resolver dúvidas e eventuais reclamações com agilidade e profissionalismo, buscando sempre a satisfação do cliente Mais Prático.

Gestão Eficiente do Setor:

  • Controlar o estoque de carnes, realizando inventários periódicos e solicitando a reposição dos produtos de forma estratégica para evitar rupturas e perdas.
  • Acompanhar e analisar as vendas do setor, identificando tendências e oportunidades para aumentar o desempenho.
  • Zelar pela organização e manutenção dos equipamentos do açougue, solicitando reparos quando necessário.
  • Garantir a correta precificação dos produtos nas vitrines, seguindo as políticas do Mais Prático.
  • Colaborar com o gerente da loja na definição de estratégias promocionais para o setor.

Hard Skills:

  • Profundo conhecimento em cortes de carnes bovina, suína, aves e outras (desossa, limpeza, tipos de corte).
  • Domínio das normas de higiene e segurança alimentar (Boas Práticas de Fabricação - BPF).
  • Experiência com controle de estoque e gestão de perdas.
  • Habilidade no manuseio de equipamentos de açougue (serras, moedores, balanças, etc.).
  • Conhecimento básico em informática (para controle de estoque e relatórios).

Soft Skills:

  • Excelente comunicação interpessoal.
  • Liderança inspiradora e capacidade de motivar equipes.
  • Foco no cliente e paixão por servir.
  • Organização e atenção aos detalhes.
  • Proatividade e iniciativa.
  • Habilidade de resolução de problemas.
  • Flexibilidade e adaptabilidade.

Habilidades Comportamentais:

  • Técnicas:Maestria em técnicas de corte e manipulação de diferentes tipos de carne.
  • Conhecimento aprofundado sobre a qualidade e as características de cada corte.
  • Capacidade de aplicar e fiscalizar as normas de higiene e segurança alimentar.

title: Risk & Audit Expert Talent
description:
Risk & Audit Expert Talent at Randstad Global

Sao Paolo - Brazil, hybrid, fulltime

people at the heart of everything we do

Working at Randstad is unlike working at any organization. Because at Randstad we put people at the heart of everything we do. This goes for our clients, our talent, our employees and society. We combine our passion for people with the power of today’s technologies. This helps us support people and organizations in realizing their true potential. We call this partner for talent..

Learn more about our mission, history and values on our website:

BR&AF

The business risk and audit function (BR&AF) provides assurance and recommendations to the Executive Board and the Audit Committee on Randstad Group’s (risk) management, control and governance practices. Therefore the department facilitates in setting governance standards. It provides advice on internal control improvements, it conducts audits, special investigations and assignments worldwide on request of the Executive Board and Audit Committee. BR&AF’s responsibility includes the quarterly reporting based on: the risk and internal control self assessments, audit results, discussions on internal control weaknesses and analysis of the key risks reported throughout the company's management structure. This also substantiates the Group’s in-control statements.

The global function consists of team members operating through hubs spread over 4 continents. The team is organized in a matrix consisting of control & audit focus teams on business and functional areas (e.g. digital, talent, client, back office & shared service centers and fraud & forensics) and partners that are the linking pin to operating units (business risk & audit partners) with a global view. A support group is set up for professional practice, learning & development, quality improvement & methods, analytics and PMO.

Representatives of the different groups (Focus teams, BR&A Partners and support group) form the BR&AF core management team that reports to the Managing Director BR&AF.

how you will contribute

You are part of the Business Risk & Audit Function (BR&AF) that covers all business operations related to Clients, Talents and our (shared) Back-, Mid- and Front offices, as well as our Accounting & Reporting and other specialist functions like HR.

With your risk & audit experience and expertise you enhance Randstad's in-control situation together with other team members. This by preparing and performing: risk assessments; internal control assessments; audits; and reviews, and compile reports on these activities that make an impact on management.

  • you provide management combined assurance, utilizing insights from enterprise risk management, internal control as well as internal audits that you lead and/or execute. Therewith you create momentum within the company to strengthen the risk-control position for our operational, shared services and accounting processes.
  • you maintain contact with local and international management, global and local process owners and collaborate closely with other involved stakeholders like other impacted functions within the group.
  • you coordinate, execute and report on the outcomes of risk management, internal control and internal audit in close collaboration with other involved and impacted functions within the group, such as: our Client delivery and Talent operations specialists; and HR, Tax, Accounting & Reporting and Planning & Control specialists.
  • you take ownership for the planning, execution and reporting of the risk, internal control and internal audit activities to make impact. You know your impact is there when management follows-up on your reports by implementing operational and control improvements.
  • you are willing to travel. As the standard office locations for the BR&AF team are organized in hubs, like in the country mentioned, travelling is estimated to be about 20% to 30% of the job.

what you will be doing

As an independent and objective risk & audit expert, you are going to:

  • participate and take the lead in risk assessments and audit planning and scoping, including researching relevant business objectives, policies, regulations.
  • prepare and execute audits by evaluating and analyzing the design and operating effectiveness of controls in mitigating identified risks.
  • execute audits and reviews for operational processes and controls, in areas such as: client delivery and Talent intake, as well as shared services operations and specialist functions like HR management, marketing & communication, finance, accounting & reporting, planning & control, non-financial reporting.
  • participate and lead audit interviews, be accountable to prepare audit workpapers and reporting, as well as assist in drafting audit findings and recommendations for management, based on identified control weaknesses or process improvements.
  • support and monitor the follow-up implementation of corrective actions by management.
  • act as a recourse for colleagues with less expertise.

who will you work with

  • Business operations managers both working with our Clients and Talents, as well as shared services center managers and functional specialists in all territories where Randstad is active
  • Business operations and shared services process owners and control owners in all territories where Randstad is active
  • Tax and Legal counterparts (including legal compliance leads) both at corporate level as well as in our operating companies
  • MD BR&AF, other BR&AF leaders, team members and business partners
  • External co-source partners

what you will bring

Your risk & audit skills are well developed, as a critical challenger to process owners and business managers you strike the right tone. You have a keen interest and business acumen for Client delivery and Talent related operational processes as well as shared services organizations, how they serve internal customers and optimize their operations. You have a broad interest in specialist functions that support the overall governance of Randstad's international presence.

As an Internal Audit Expert you:

  • have minimum 8 years of relevant experience
  • have minimum master degree in business or economics and related accreditation (e.g. CPA/CA/CIA/ACCA)
  • have level BEC B1/B2 or higher Business English, preferably combined with proficiency in one of the following languages: Dutch, Spanish, French, Italian and /or German
  • have a strong independent mindset
  • are experienced in international stakeholder management & change
  • are an innovative thinker that challenges the status quo
  • have experience with excel in risk & audit methodologies & tools and internal control theories
  • have an agile and flexible working style and passion for on the job learning & development
  • have a proven track record in control design & implementation, risk based auditing and reporting.
  • are experienced in performing integrated audits working with changing teams
  • are specialized depth and breadth of expertise in business process risk analysis
  • have experience with data driven analysis

your competencies

Within Randstad we defined the following Leadership competencies:

  • delighting people: connect people (client, talent, employee, society), building strong client relationships and delivering client-centric solutions.
  • performing today: resourcefulness securing and developing resources effectively and efficiently.
  • leading change: manages ambiguity operating effectively, even when things are not certain or the way forward is not clear.
  • securing the future: drives vision and purpose painting a compelling picture of the vision and strategy that motivates others into action.
  • creating clarity - showing line of sight: making sense of complex, high quantity and sometimes contradictory information to effectively solve problems and provides direction, is delegating and removing obstacles to get work done
  • courage to challenge: shows courage and confidence to speak up skillfully, challenging others even when they are confronted with resistance or unfamiliar circumstances
  • collaborates, reaches out, you excel in organizational sensitivity: maneuvering comfortably through complex policy, process and people-related organizational dynamics recognizing the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to an organization

what’s in it for you

We put people at the heart of everything we do. Our employment conditions reflect this and are in accordance with the applicable (local) Randstad employment policies and related personnel guide.

We want our teams and talent to reflect the rich diversity of the societies we serve. We thrive for an environment of belonging, safety and confidence. So everyone can bring their whole selves to work and flourish. Learn more about equity, diversity, inclusion and belonging at randstad .

If you recognize yourself in the profile above, we invite you to apply for this role. For more information you can reach out to our recruitment business partner:

The recruitment procedure consists of a screening and at least two interviews. Later in the process, an (online) assessment and a job offer conversation take place.

To apply, please submit your resume (CV) and a cover letter.

title: Project Engineer
description:
Project Engineer – Substations & High Voltage

(ENGLISH SPEAKERS)

Location: The Netherlands (on-site), 1-2 - year contract with potential of permanent employment, NOT project/freelance

Are you passionate about large-scale infrastructure and high-voltage energy systems? Join a forward-thinking engineering team dedicated to delivering cutting-edge solutions in substations (up to 500kV) and energy transmission projects across global markets.

We're looking for an experienced Project Engineer to support the design, development, and delivery of substation and high-voltage projects. You’ll collaborate with a multidisciplinary team, contribute to energy transition solutions, and bring excellence to our electromechanical and protection systems.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Develop basic and executive electromechanical designs for high-voltage substations (69kV to 500kV)
  • Prepare and analyze layout drawings, grounding mesh, cable routing, and auxiliary systems (AC/DC)
  • Design single-line, three-line, and interconnection diagrams
  • Ensure compliance with international standards (IEC, ANSI, IEEE, ABNT)
  • Perform technical documentation review and approval (FATs, BOMs, technical specs)
  • Interface with clients, suppliers, and cross-functional engineering teams
  • Contribute to engineering reports including ROI, CAPEX, and technical feasibility

What We’re Looking For:

  • Degree in Electrical Engineering or related field
  • Minimum 4+ years of experience in high-voltage substation design (preferred: 230kV to 500kV)
  • Proficiency with AutoCAD (See Electrical, Eplan P8 or similar is a plus)
  • Familiarity with SCADA, protection and control systems
  • Solid knowledge of substation equipment: CTs, PTs, surge arresters, circuit breakers, transformers, disconnectors
  • Experience with software like CYMCAP, DiaLUX, PVsyst (nice to have)
  • Strong communication skills and ability to work in multicultural environments
  • English proficiency required; Portuguese or Spanish is a plus

Bonus:

  • Experience with renewable projects (photovoltaic farms, hybrid systems)
  • Exposure to EPC projects and multidisciplinary coordination
  • Understanding of ESG practices in engineering

Why Join Us:

  • Work with industry leaders in power and energy systems
  • Get involved in international projects with real impact
  • Grow within a dynamic and mission-driven company
  • Remote flexibility and a collaborative, innovation-driven culture

Who is Xelvin?

Xelvin is a Dutch consultancy company specializing in Engineering and Technical Trades. We hire Artisans, National Degree, Bachelor, Masters and PHD candidates with a background in Mechatronics, Electronics, Electrical, Mechanical, Automotive and Physics. Our focus is within the High-Tech and Manufacturing industry in Eindhoven region.

Xelvin is specialized in International Recruitment, within Europe and beyond. In the past years we have helped over a thousand candidates from more than 50 different nationalities with finding their perfect job here in the Netherlands and are striving to help so many more!

As Xelvin we hire candidates for a specific position for a set amount of time, after which a permanent contract with our client is granted and the candidates automatically transfers.

What do we offer?

Contract wise:

· 1-2 year contract of 40 hours per week (with potential of long-term employment).

· 25 paid holidays a year (+ potential ADV days)

· Public holidays, with a maximum of 7 per year, which are paid by Xelvin.

· Holiday allowance of 8.33% (instead of 8,0%) over your total gross annual income. Paid each year in May.

· Overtime and shift allowance will be paid by Xelvin accordingly.

· Travel allowance of €0,23 per km, for the use of travelling to work and back home.

· Competitive salary (based on level of education and experience)

Onboarding & benefits:

· Your 1st house in the Netherlands will be supported by Xelvin, with the help of our Housing Consultant (we help you find accommodation). In case of having to pay the 1st months rent or potential deposit, Xelvin is willing to pay it for you upfront, after which we’ll set up a loan agreement, for you to pay us back in terms.

· A relocation assistance allowance of €1000 - €3000,00 NET will be paid to you, to assist with the cost of relocating to the Netherlands.

· You (and your family/partner) will be picked up at the airport or train station by your consultant/ recruiter after your arrival and will be taken to your new house.

· Onboarding: we’ll advise you on how to set up a Dutch bank account, apply for health insurance, getting a Dutch BSN number, writing in with a dentist and general practitioner and other useful or necessary cases to arrange.

· New Hire Dinner organized for all newly recruited engineers to make them aware of our Dutch tax system and explaining the Dutch payslip.

· A few social gatherings with all Xelvin employees and recruited engineers;

o New Years drink at the local PSV stadium, where you’ll get a tour of the building and beverages and bites are served.

o Summer BBQ at the Evoluon, where you can grow your social circle and dance to some nice music while enjoying the food.

title: Investment Banking | Intern Position (São Paulo)
description:
Euro Latina Finance

Established in early 2010 by the former Global Head of M&A at Groupe Casino (1998 - 2010), Euro Latina Finance is a French truly independent financial advisory firm specialized in cross-border transactions between Europe and Latin America.

With fully operational regional offices and local teams in Paris, São Paulo, and Bogotá, Euro Latina Finance provides tailor-made M&A and strategic advice to a portfolio of international blue-chip clients. We specialize in cross-border M&A transactions between Europe/US and Latin America ranging from US$200mm – US$1bn+, across a wide array of sectors.

Since its inception, Euro Latina Finance has advised 28 successful transactions on a total of c. 60 M&A projects, including some of the most complex, transformational, and landmark cross-border deals into/from Latin America such as the acquisition of Walmart Brasil by Advent (US/Brazil), the restructuring of Vale New Caledonia (France/Brazil) or the advisory of French industrial laundry group Elis’ on its build-up strategy in LatAm (8 transactions of all sizes advised over 8 years).

Description of the Position:

The Location : São Paulo office located in Itaim Bibi

The Role : M&A Intern

The Intern will be involved in the origination and execution of mergers and acquisitions transactions, including the following tasks: preparation of internal and client presentations (pitches, company profiles, teasers, CIM,…), participation in financial and valuation analysis, participation in meetings or calls with international clients along with the senior team from Euro Latina Finance.

Who are we looking for?

Candidates motivated to work in a dynamic, challenging, multicultural and fast-paced professional environment, holding sharp analytical skills and able to manage various transactions simultaneously.

  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills with the team and different clients across the globe, capable of fostering strong networking, contributing to a highly valued positive culture
  • Diligent and intellectually curious with a strong work ethic and a drive to succeed
  • Rigorous, hard-working, highly motivated, and skilled team-player who can demonstrate analytical skills and engagement to the team and to our clients

Qualifications

  • Full availability to work in our São Paulo office (Itaim Bibi), as this is a 100% on-site position
  • High academic credentials from a leading business and/or engineering school and/or top-tier university
  • Solid background in finance and accounting, exceptional sense of rigor and attention to details and ability to work efficiently under time pressure
  • Previous experience in an IB or PE firm is a preferred qualification
  • Fluency (writing, reading, and speaking) in Portuguese and English (French and/or Spanish would be highly valued)
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Superior level of command of MS-Office Tools, namely Excel and PowerPoint
  • Expected graduation in Jul/26, Dez/26 or later

Why Euro Latina Finance?

  • You will be part of a global and multicultural team that is based in three different locations across Latin America and Europe and is led by its founder and CEO
  • Play a key role and contribute to the transformational phase of a growing and recognized M&A advisory firm with a solid pipeline and strong deal flow
  • High exposure to a vast array of sectors, top-notch companies, and deal complexity, in a multi-language and cultural environment
  • Runway to grow in a dynamic, unbureaucratic, challenging, and collaborative environment, with great potential for professional development and career promotions

title: Senior Murex FO - Strong Murex experience is must!
description:

DXC Luxoft has one of the world's leading Murex practices. We are a top-tier Murex Alliance Partner and a market leader in implementation, integration, upgrade, and migration.
